steps.q: What was Nodira doing at nine o'clock?
steps.explain_uz: "I was watching a film with my sister."

steps.body_uz:
O'tmishdagi **aniq bir paytda davom etayotgan** ish uchun: "soat to'qqizda film ko'rayotgan edim".
Tuzilma: **was / were + fe'l-ing**
**I / he / she / it — was**: I **was watching**. She **was cooking**.
**you / we / they — were**: We **were having** dinner.
Inkor: **wasn't / weren't**: He **wasn't sleeping**.
Savol: **What were you doing** at 9? · **Was** she **working**? — Yes, she **was**. / No, she **wasn't**.
Taqqoslang: Past Simple — **tugagan** ish: I **watched** a film yesterday. Past Continuous — **o'sha paytda davom etayotgan**: At 9 I **was watching** a film.
⚠️ know, like, want, need bilan -ing ishlatilmaydi: "I was knowing" — xato, **I knew**.

examples.en: At seven o'clock I was having breakfast.
They were playing football in the park.
She wasn't listening to the teacher.
What were you doing yesterday at five?
examples.uz: Kecha soat beshda nima qilayotgan edingiz?

lessons.title: I was walking home when it started to rain
lessons.goal_uz: Kichik voqeani hikoya qilasiz: davom etayotgan ish (was walking) va uni to'xtatgan qisqa voqea (when it started to rain).

words.ex: Be careful! Don't slip on the ice.
He slipped and fell over. (fell — o'tgan zamon)

steps.title: A bad morning
steps.text: Last winter, I was walking to school when it started to snow. Soon the streets were very icy. While I was crossing the road, I saw my friend Jamshid on the other side. I waved to him, and suddenly I slipped and fell over! My phone fell out of my pocket and the screen broke. Luckily, I didn't hurt myself. Jamshid was laughing while he was helping me up. "What happened?" he asked. "I was looking at you, not at the road!" I said.
steps.uz: O'tgan qishda maktabga ketayotganimda qor yog'a boshladi. Tez orada ko'chalar juda toyg'oq bo'lib qoldi. Yo'ldan o'tayotganimda narigi tomonda do'stim Jamshidni ko'rdim. Unga qo'l silkidim va birdan sirpanib yiqildim! Telefonim cho'ntagimdan tushib ketdi va ekrani sindi. Xayriyat, o'zim lat yemadim. Jamshid turishimga yordam berar ekan, kulayotgan edi. "Nima bo'ldi?" — deb so'radi u. "Men yo'lga emas, senga qarayotgan edim!" — dedim.

steps.q: Why did the writer fall over?
options: He was looking at Jamshid, not the road.

steps.body_uz:
Hikoyada ikki xil o'tgan zamon birga ishlatiladi:
**Past Continuous** — uzoqroq, fon ish (davom etayotgan edi)
**Past Simple** — qisqa voqea, fonni "bo'lib qo'yadi"
**... when + Past Simple**: I **was walking** home **when** it **started** to rain.
**While + Past Continuous, ...**: **While** I **was crossing** the road, I **saw** my friend.
Ikki uzun ish bir vaqtda: **While** I **was cooking**, my brother **was cleaning**.
Tinish belgisi: when / while qismi **boshida** kelsa — vergul qo'yiladi: When the phone rang**,** I was sleeping.

lessons.title: When I was a child, I could...
lessons.title_uz: O'tmish: could / couldn't · there was / were
lessons.goal_uz: Bolaligingiz va o'tmish haqida gapirasiz: nimani qila olardingiz (could) va qayerda nima bor edi (there was / there were).

words.ex: My grandparents live in a village.
The children played in the fields.
He could ride a horse at six.

steps.title: My grandfather's childhood
steps.text: My grandfather grew up in a small village near Bukhara. There wasn't a TV in his house until he was twelve, and there weren't any shops in the village — only a small bazaar on Fridays. There was one school, and there were only twelve children in his class. He couldn't watch cartoons, but he could ride a horse when he was six! He and his friends could climb the tallest trees in the fields. "We didn't have many toys," he says, "but we were never bored."
steps.uz: Bobom Buxoro yaqinidagi kichik qishloqda ulg'aygan. U o'n ikki yoshga to'lguncha uyida televizor yo'q edi, qishloqda esa birorta ham do'kon yo'q edi — faqat juma kunlari kichik bozor bo'lardi. Bitta maktab bor edi, uning sinfida esa atigi o'n ikki bola bor edi. U multfilm ko'ra olmasdi, lekin olti yoshida ot mina olardi! U do'stlari bilan daladagi eng baland daraxtlarga chiqa olardi. "O'yinchoqlarimiz ko'p emas edi, — deydi u, — lekin hech qachon zerikmasdik."

steps.q: What could the grandfather do when he was six?
steps.explain_uz: "he could ride a horse when he was six".

steps.q: How many children were in his class?
steps.explain_uz: "there were only twelve children in his class".

steps.title_uz: could / couldn't va there was / there were
steps.body_uz:
**could + fe'l** — o'tmishdagi qobiliyat ("qila olardim"). **can** ning o'tgan zamoni.
I **could** swim when I was five. · She **couldn't** read at four.
Savol: **Could** you swim? — Yes, I **could**. / No, I **couldn't**.
(⚠️ **Could you help me?** — bu esa xushmuomala iltimos, o'tmish emas.)
**there was / there were** — "... bor edi" (**there is / are** ning o'tgan zamoni):
**There was** + bitta: There **was** a school.
**There were** + ko'p: There **were** twelve children.
Inkor: There **wasn't** a TV. · There **weren't any** shops.
Savol: **Was there** a park? · **Were there** any shops?

steps.prompt: Write about your childhood. What could and couldn't you do? What was there in your town or village?
steps.example: I grew up in a small town near Fergana. There was a river near our house, and there were a lot of fruit trees in our garden. When I was seven, I could swim very well, but I couldn't ride a bike. There wasn't a cinema in our town, so we watched films at home. There were only two shops in our street. I didn't have many toys, but I was never bored because I could play outside with my friends all day.
